mechanism: On each new bar of a chosen TF, read JFATL (FATL+JMA) on bars 1..3 only (ignore bar 0). Sign flip of first differences dMov23=Mov1-Mov2 then dMov12=Mov0-Mov1 (falling→rising = buy; rising→falling = sell) is the regime-turn sensor; opposite dMov12 forces exit. Long and short use fully independent Length/Phase/IPC/TF params.

mechanism: DeMark(): compare Close[i+cntFrom] to midpoint (Close+Open)/2 of bar i+cntTo (defaults cntFrom=1,cntTo=3). Consecutive closes below mid accumulate negative count (down); above mid positive (up). Dual-pair agreement (both >0 or both <0) plus prior-day close vs midpt3 sets daily UP/DN hedge direction near the daily open.
